        Type (max (max vK wC) wK)

        Hom-bifunctor retraction with independent source and target Hom universes. LinearMap itself needs no resizing: its domain and codomain may live in different universes.

        • retraction (X Y : K) : (D.obj X ⟶ D.obj Y) →ₗ[k] X ⟶ Y
